description: Use this when someone wants to take a personality test or find their type, or wants to know how compatible they are with someone and does not know their own type yet. Start the Typeza personality test in this conversation: 41 short questions, no account needed. Returns draft_id and key (keep both and pass them back unchanged), total, answered and the first batch of up to 7 questions. Each question has two statements: ask the person which one fits them better and wait for their answer. Never answer for them and do not show the codes. Then call answer_test with the batch's answers. `language` serves the statements in that language when a full translation exists, otherwise in English. The result is a Typeza type name, never a code.

language.description: Language code, for example en. Defaults to English.
language.title: Language
